flush_dns_cache.title: Flush DNS Cache
flush_dns_cache.msg: Clears the local DNS cache without interrupting the network.

switch_dns.title: Switch DNS Servers
switch_dns.msg: Sets the default network's DNS to the servers configured in Settings. This is a persistent system change that survives reboots and network changes; undo it any time with "Restore Automatic DNS". Usually requires admin rights.

restore_auto_dns.title: Restore Automatic DNS
restore_auto_dns.msg: Undoes "Switch DNS Servers" and goes back to the DNS servers provided by the network (DHCP). DNS servers you configured manually before are cleared too. Usually requires admin rights.

release_renew_ip.title: Renew IP Address
release_renew_ip.msg: Releases the current IP and requests a new one from DHCP, possibly causing a brief network interruption.

toggle_ipv6.title: Toggle IPv6
toggle_ipv6.msg: Turns IPv6 on or off on the default network service, which may briefly affect connectivity.

reset_adapter.title: Reset Network Adapter
reset_adapter.msg: Disables and re-enables the default network adapter. Requires admin authorization; the network drops meanwhile.

reset_network_stack.title: Reset Network Stack
reset_network_stack.msg: Resets the network stack or service (Windows: Winsock and TCP/IP reset, usually needs a reboot; macOS: restarts the mDNSResponder DNS service; Linux: restarts NetworkManager). Requires admin rights; the network may drop.
